questions.stem: What is the term used for the money deposited in a bank?
questions.solution: The correct term is 'Deposit' because it refers to the money placed into a bank by an individual or organization. 'Loan' is money borrowed from a bank, 'Interest' is the extra money earned on a deposit, and 'Principal' is the original amount of a deposit before any interest is added.

questions.stem: What is the term for the amount of money deposited in a bank or given by the bank to the borrower?
questions.solution: The term for the amount of money deposited in a bank or given by the bank to the borrower is 'principal.' 'Interest' refers to the additional money paid on top of the principal, 'amount' is the total sum of principal and interest, and 'rate' is the percentage used to calculate interest.

questions.stem: What is the term for the amount of money that the bank pays to the depositor or charges from the borrower?

questions.stem: What is the purpose of a savings account?
choices: To save money and develop a habit of saving
questions.solution: The purpose of a savings account is to help individuals save money and build a habit of saving, which supports financial discipline. Conducting large financial transactions is typically handled by checking or business accounts, providing loans to businesses is the role of banks or financial institutions, and keeping valuables safe is managed through secure storage options like safety deposit boxes.

questions.stem: If a bank offers 4% simple interest per annum, how much money will be in the account after 2 years if ₹10,000 is deposited?
questions.solution: The total amount after 2 years will be ₹10,800. Simple interest for 2 years is ₹800 (4% of ₹10,000 per year), so the total is ₹10,000 + ₹800 = ₹10,800. The other options are incorrect: ₹10,400 is for 1 year, ₹11,200 is for 6% interest, and ₹11,600 is for 8% interest.

hi.stem: यदि एक बैंक 4% साधारण ब्याज प्रति वर्ष प्रदान करता है, तो ₹10,000 जमा कराने पर 2 वर्ष बाद खाते में कितनी राशि होगी?
hi.solution: 2 वर्ष बाद कुल राशि ₹10,800 होगी। 2 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज ₹800 (प्रति वर्ष ₹10,000 का 4%) है, इसलिए कुल राशि ₹10,000 + ₹800 = ₹10,800 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं: ₹10,400 एक वर्ष के लिए है, ₹11,200 छः प्रतिशत ब्याज के लिए है और ₹11,600 आठ प्रतिशत ब्याज के लिए है।

questions.stem: Nancy took a loan of ₹18,650 at the rate of 10 p.c.p.a. from a bank to buy a sewing machine. What amount will she have to pay after one year?

questions.stem: If the principal is ₹35,000 and the interest is ₹2,800, what is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution: The correct answer is '8%' because the rate is calculated as (Interest ÷ Principal) × 100 = (2,800 ÷ 35,000) × 100 = 8%. The other options are incorrect as they do not match the calculated rate.
